import sys
from docx import Document

doc = Document(sys.argv[1])
body = doc.element.body
from docx.table import Table
from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph

for child in body.iterchildren():
    tag = child.tag.split('}')[-1]
    if tag == 'p':
        p = Paragraph(child, doc)
        numpr = child.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}numPr')
        marker = f"[{p.style.name}]" + (" <numPr>" if numpr is not None else "")
        if p.text.strip():
            print(f"{marker} {p.text}")
    elif tag == 'tbl':
        t = Table(child, doc)
        print(f"<TABLE {len(t.rows)}x{len(t.columns)}>")
        for r in t.rows:
            print("  | " + " | ".join(c.text.strip() for c in r.cells))
print(f"\ntables={len(doc.tables)} paragraphs={len(doc.paragraphs)}")

import zipfile, re, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
z=zipfile.ZipFile('supplier.docx')
xml=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
body=xml.split('<w:body>')[1]
# walk top-level blocks
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ns={'w':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
root=ET.fromstring(xml)
b=root.find('w:body',ns)
i=0
for el in b:
    tag=el.tag.split('}')[1]
    if tag=='p':
        i+=1
        txt=''.join(t.text or '' for t in el.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}t'))
        st=el.find('.//w:pStyle',ns)
        style=st.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}val') if st is not None else ''
        numpr = el.find('.//w:numPr',ns)
        print(f'P{i} [{style}]{\" <num>\" if numpr is not None else \"\"}: {txt!r}')
    elif tag=='tbl':
        print('--- TABLE ---')
        for r,row in enumerate(el.findall('w:tr',ns),1):
            cells=[]
            for c in row.findall('w:tc',ns):
                cells.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in c.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}t')))
            print(f'  R{r}: ' + ' | '.join(cells))
        print('--- END TABLE ---')
"

import zipfile, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
ns={'w':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
W='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
z=zipfile.ZipFile('supplier.docx')
root=ET.fromstring(z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8'))
b=root.find('w:body',ns)
i=0
for el in b:
    tag=el.tag.split('}')[1]
    if tag=='p':
        i+=1
        txt=''.join(t.text or '' for t in el.iter(W+'t'))
        st=el.find('.//w:pStyle',ns)
        style=st.get(W+'val') if st is not None else ''
        numpr = el.find('.//w:numPr',ns)
        print('P%d [%s]%s: %r' % (i, style, ' num' if numpr is not None else '', txt))
    elif tag=='tbl':
        print('--- TABLE ---')
        for r,row in enumerate(el.findall('w:tr',ns),1):
            cells=[]
            for c in row.findall('w:tc',ns):
                cells.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in c.iter(W+'t')))
